title: Semantic Intent Drift Analyzer
short: Score how far each query fan-out drifts from the intent of your target query, and see the spread in a 3D plot.
needs: Nothing: it runs in your browser
cost: Free. Semantic Boost downloads a model of about 27 MB the first time you use it.
inputs: A target query and its fan-outs, one per line, or a CSV with Target Query and Query Fan-Outs columns
outputs: A similarity score, drift score and drift band per fan-out, a 3D plot, and a CSV export
how: Enter your target query and paste the fan-outs, one per line.
Switch on Semantic Boost if synonyms and context should count, not just shared words.
Press Analyse drift and read the table from the top: the closest fan-outs come first.
Hover the nodes in the 3D plot to see each fan-out's scores.
Export the CSV, or upload a CSV of query pairs to score a whole list at once.
note: With Semantic Boost on, even unrelated queries rarely score below about 30% similarity, so compare fan-outs with each other rather than treating the drift bands as fixed verdicts.
